products.description_html:
Move freely. Live fully.

Sanan Pain Relief Oil is a modern, plant-based recovery oil formulated for the way you actually live — long hours at the desk, hard training days, and joints that have carried you for decades. Sixteen carefully balanced botanicals, led by Vijaya leaf extract, work together to ease pain at the source and calm the tension that builds up in muscles, joints, and nerves.

Clinically studied. Non-greasy. Made in India by the pioneers of the Vijaya industry since 1985.

How It Works

Your body has a built-in pain-management system called the endocannabinoid system (ECS) — a network of receptors sitting in your skin, muscles, joints, and nerves. Its job is to keep pain signals in balance and help your body recover. When you strain a muscle or a joint gets inflamed, that system can get overwhelmed and the pain turns up loud.

Sanan Pain Relief Oil works with this natural system, in four steps:

  1. Absorbs deep. A pure mustard oil base carries the actives past the surface and into the tissue underneath — where the pain actually lives.
  2. Turns the signal down. Vijaya leaf extract meets your ECS receptors at the site and helps dial down the pain messaging travelling to your brain.
  3. Cools, then warms. Camphor and mint cool the surface for instant relief. Wintergreen, ginger, and capsicum warm underneath — drawing fresh blood to the area to speed recovery.
  4. Calms inflammation. Nirgundi, Salai Guggal (Boswellia), and ginger work on the underlying swelling that keeps pain going — so relief lasts hours, not minutes.

Because it acts right where it hurts, relief is targeted, fast, and long-lasting.

Clinically Proven Performance

  • Relief begins in an average of 77.67 seconds of application
  • Up to 11 hours of continuous action per application
  • 43.5% reduction in overall pain intensity over 14 days
  • 24% reduction in ESR — a marker of underlying inflammation
  • 4.9/5 spreadability rating — non-greasy, absorbs cleanly
  • Zero adverse events reported in clinical trial

Key Benefits

Desk life & posture strain

  • Eases “tech neck” and shoulder tension from screens and laptops
  • Soothes lower back aches from long hours of sitting
  • Relieves wrist and forearm strain from typing and scrolling
  • Loosens cramped muscles after long flights or drives

Active life & training recovery

  • Calms post-workout soreness and DOMS after a tough session
  • Speeds recovery from sprains, twisted ankles, and minor pulls
  • Gentle care for the everyday knocks and bruises of an active life

Joints, nerves & long-standing discomfort

  • Keeps knees, elbows, and fingers moving without heavy stiffness
  • Targeted relief for the sharp, tingling, or burning sensations of nerve irritation
  • Gentle tissue support during post-procedure recovery

Everyday wellness

  • A warming, natural rescue for period cramps — massage into the lower abdomen
  • Fixes the “pain in the neck” from an awkward night’s sleep

How to use: Take a few drops on clean, dry skin. Massage gently over the affected area until fully absorbed. Reapply as needed, up to 3 times daily. For external use only.

Ayurvedic Proprietary Medicine · 30 ml

products.description_html:
GUMMY VATI PLUS

 

KEY BENEFITS

Primary Therapeutic Actions:

  • Stress & Anxiety Management – Natural adaptogenic herbs help regulate cortisol levels and promote mental calmness
  • Sleep Quality Enhancement – Supports long hours of restful, rejuvenating sleep through natural sedative properties
  • Muscle Relaxation & Anti-inflammatory – Reduces muscle tension and inflammation throughout the body

COMPOSITION (Per Gummy)

Ingredient Percentage Therapeutic Role
Ashwagandha 11% Adaptogen for stress relief and anxiety management
Pippali Mool 10% Respiratory support and bioavailability enhancer
Arjun Tvak 10% Cardiovascular support and stress management
Haritaki 10% Digestive health and detoxification
Shunthi 8% Anti-inflammatory and digestive support
Nimbu Sat 7% Vitamin C source and flavor enhancement
Vijaya 5% Natural relaxant and sleep inducer
Sodium Citrate 4% Stabilizer and pH regulator
Permitted Flavour 2% Natural taste enhancement
Sugar 15% Natural sweetener and base
Glucose 15% Energy source and texture
Setting Agent 5% Gummy formation and stability

Total: 100%

CLINICAL INDICATIONS

Primary Conditions:

  • Sleep disorders and insomnia
  • Anxiety and stress-related conditions
  • Depression and mood disorders
  • Muscle tension and inflammation

Therapeutic Category: Anxiolytic, Sedative, Adaptogenic, Anti-inflammatory

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS

Physical Characteristics:

  • Form: Chewable gummies
  • Color: Natural herb-derived
  • Texture: Soft, chewy consistency
  • Flavor: Naturally flavored with permitted additives

Storage Conditions:

  • Store in cool, dry place
  • Protect from direct sunlight
  • Keep container tightly closed
  • Store below 30°C temperature

Shelf Life: 24 months from date of manufacture

REGULATORY INFORMATION

Licensing & Compliance:

  • Drug License No.: 25D/55/96
  • Excise License No.: 22/2022/0022
  • Classification: Ayurvedic Proprietary Medicine
  • Regulatory Status: Approved under Ayush Ministry guidelines
  • MSME Registered: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises certified

 

Quality Assurance:

  • GMP compliant manufacturing facility
  • Quality tested at multiple stages
  • Standardized herbal extracts used
  • Consistent potency and purity

AYURVEDIC PRINCIPLES

Dosha Balance: Primarily balances Vata and Pitta doshas Rasa (Taste): Madhura (Sweet), Tikta (Bitter), Katu (Pungent) Virya (Potency): Sheeta (Cooling) and Ushna (Warming) combination Prabhava (Special Effect): Medhya (Brain tonic) and Nidrajanana (Sleep inducing)

SAFETY INFORMATION

Contraindications:

  • Pregnancy and lactation (consult physician)
  • Children under 12 years (medical supervision required)
  • Severe cardiac conditions (professional guidance needed)

Drug Interactions: Inform physician about concurrent medications, especially sedatives or anxiolytics.

products.title: Pain Relief Patch (pack of 5)
products.short_description: Easy-to-apply herbal patches infused with Vijaya (hemp) leaf extract and natural botanicals, designed for long-lasting comfort from muscle and joint stiffness. Ideal for targeted, on-the-go relief.
products.short_description_html: Easy-to-apply herbal patches infused with Vijaya (hemp) leaf extract and natural botanicals, designed for long-lasting comfort from muscle and joint stiffness. Ideal for targeted, on-the-go relief.
products.description: The Sanan India Pain Relief Patch offers a simple, mess-free way to experience herbal comfort. Each patch is infused with Vijaya (hemp) leaf extract and other plant-based ingredients, providing targeted, sustained relief to muscles and joints. Perfect for use during daily activities, workouts, or while traveling, these patches are discreet and easy to wear under clothing. Produced in ISO & GMP-certified facilities and licensed under the Ministry of Ayush , every pack is made with care and quality. Key Benefits Long-Lasting Support: Delivers steady herbal comfort for several hours. Targeted Action: Place directly over the affected area for maximum effectiveness. Convenient & Discreet: Slim, comfortable design that fits under clothes. Natural Care: Contains Vijaya leaf extract and selected herbal compounds. Mess-Free Application: No spills, no greasiness — just peel and stick. How to Use Clean and dry the affected area. Peel off the protective backing. Apply the patch directly to the skin over the discomfort area. Remove after the recommended duration mentioned on the packaging. Ideal For Lower back stiffness Shoulder and neck discomfort Joint aches after activity On-the-go herbal care Storage Instructions Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep patches sealed until use. Note For external use only. Avoid applying to broken or irritated skin. Discontinue use if redness or irritation occurs.
products.description_html:
The Sanan India Pain Relief Patch offers a simple, mess-free way to experience herbal comfort. Each patch is infused with Vijaya (hemp) leaf extract and other plant-based ingredients, providing targeted, sustained relief to muscles and joints.
Perfect for use during daily activities, workouts, or while traveling, these patches are discreet and easy to wear under clothing.

Produced in ISO & GMP-certified facilities and licensed under the Ministry of Ayush, every pack is made with care and quality.

Key Benefits

  • Long-Lasting Support: Delivers steady herbal comfort for several hours.

  • Targeted Action: Place directly over the affected area for maximum effectiveness.

  • Convenient & Discreet: Slim, comfortable design that fits under clothes.

  • Natural Care: Contains Vijaya leaf extract and selected herbal compounds.

  • Mess-Free Application: No spills, no greasiness — just peel and stick.

How to Use

  1. Clean and dry the affected area.

  2. Peel off the protective backing.

  3. Apply the patch directly to the skin over the discomfort area.

  4. Remove after the recommended duration mentioned on the packaging.

Ideal For

  • Lower back stiffness

  • Shoulder and neck discomfort

  • Joint aches after activity

  • On-the-go herbal care

Storage Instructions

Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep patches sealed until use.

Note

For external use only. Avoid applying to broken or irritated skin. Discontinue use if redness or irritation occurs.

products.description_html:
The Sanan India Pain Relief Gel is a non-greasy, fast-acting formula created to help ease muscle and joint discomfort. Enriched with Vijaya (hemp) leaf extract and carefully selected herbal ingredients, this gel delivers a cooling effect that helps relax stiffness and refresh tired areas.

Produced in ISO & GMP-certified facilities and licensed under the Ministry of Ayush, every batch meets our high standards of safety and quality.

Key Benefits

  • Quick Relief: Provides a refreshing cooling sensation that helps relax stiff muscles.

  • Targeted Action: Ideal for localized discomfort in joints, back, neck, or shoulders.

  • Fast Absorption: Lightweight gel texture that leaves no sticky residue.

  • Natural Care: Combines plant-based extracts with traditional herbal wisdom.

  • Travel-Friendly: Compact packaging for easy, on-the-go application.

How to Use

  1. Apply a small amount of gel to the affected area.

  2. Massage gently in circular motions until fully absorbed.

  3. Use 2–3 times daily or as required.

  4. For external use only.

Ideal For

  • Muscle stiffness after workouts

  • Neck and shoulder tension

  • Joint discomfort from daily activities

  • Quick refresh during travel or work

Storage Instructions

Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Close the cap tightly after use.

Note

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes, mouth, or broken skin. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.

products.description_html:
Overview

The Sanan India Pain Relief Roll-On is a compact, travel-friendly solution for managing everyday muscle and joint discomfort. Made with carefully selected herbal ingredients and Vijaya (hemp) leaf extract, it delivers targeted relief where you need it most — anytime, anywhere.

Key Benefits

  • Targeted Application: Easy-to-use roll-on format for precise relief on affected areas.

  • Natural Ingredients: Infused with Vijaya leaf extract, essential oils, and soothing herbal compounds.

  • Fast Absorption: Lightweight, non-greasy formula that penetrates quickly into the skin.

  • On-the-Go Relief: Ideal for use at work, home, or while traveling.

  • Quality Assurance: Produced in ISO & GMP-certified facilities and licensed under the Ministry of Ayush.

How to Use

  1. Shake gently before use.

  2. Apply directly to the affected area using the roll-on applicator.

  3. Massage lightly for better absorption.

  4. Use as needed, up to 3–4 times daily.

Ideal For

  • Muscle stiffness after physical activity

  • Joint discomfort from daily movement

  • Temporary relief after sports or exercise

Storage Instructions

Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of children.

Note

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and broken skin. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
